overview: Tenebrous Depths is the subterranean heart of the Tenebrous Mountains, a mega-dungeon shaped by resonance instability and faction warfare.
history: The Depths formed from ancient Luclin tectonics and resonance erosion.
Vampyric Courts established throne chambers deep within the caverns.
Akhevan ritualists breached the Depths seeking shadow resonance.
Umbral Vanguard forces descended to contain resonance storms.
Territory control has shifted for centuries, with no faction able to dominate.
hooks: A resonance storm destabilizes the Core.
Akhevan ritualists attempt a shadow breach.
Vampyric nobles perform a blood resonance ritual.
Umbral Vanguard forces request assistance stabilizing the Depths.
